tagline: A community-focused regional bank serving the Mid-Atlantic and Northeast with retail and commercial banking, wealth management, and trust services.
hero_kpi_rationale: Net Income is the primary indicator of the bank's overall financial performance. It reflects its ability to generate profits from its banking and wealth management activities.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Total profit earned by the company after deducting all expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: Net Income increased by 10% in 2025 compared to 2024, reaching $2,851 million.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.explanation: Total value of all assets held by the company.
kpis.description: Total assets increased by 2.6% to reach $213,510 million at the end of 2025.

kpis.name: Shareholders Equity
kpis.explanation: Net value of assets belonging to shareholders.
kpis.description: Shareholders Equity amounted to $29,177 million at the end of 2025.

kpis.name: Net Interest Income
kpis.explanation: Difference between interest income generated by assets and interest paid on liabilities.
kpis.description: Net Interest Income increased by 1% to reach $6,948 million in 2025.
kpis.signal: Slight increase in net interest income.

kpis.name: Other Income
kpis.explanation: Income from sources other than net interest, such as service fees.
kpis.description: Other Income increased by 13% in 2025, reaching $2,742 million, driven by mortgage and service fee revenues.

kpis.name: Provision for Credit Losses
kpis.explanation: Amount set aside to cover potential loan losses.
kpis.description: Provision for Credit Losses decreased by 17% in 2025, reflecting improved loan quality.
kpis.signal: Significant reduction in credit loss provisions.

kpis.name: Return on Average Assets
kpis.explanation: Measure of profitability relative to average assets held.
kpis.description: Return on Average Assets improved by 0.12 percentage points to reach 1.35% in 2025.

kpis.short: Return on Average Common Shareholders' Equity
kpis.name: Return on Average Common Shareholders' Equity
kpis.explanation: Measure of profitability relative to average common shareholders' equity.
kpis.description: Return on Average Common Shareholders' Equity increased by 0.73 percentage points to reach 10.27% in 2025.

kpis.name: Efficiency Ratio
kpis.explanation: Measure of operating expenses relative to revenue, indicating operational efficiency.
kpis.description: The Efficiency Ratio improved by 0.9 percentage points to reach 56.0% in 2025, indicating better cost management.

kpis.name: Diluted Earnings Per Share
kpis.explanation: Net income attributable to common shareholders, adjusted for the dilutive effects of potential shares.
kpis.description: Diluted Earnings Per Share increased by 16% in 2025 to reach $17.00.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in earnings per share.

kpis.name: Net Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Net income adjusted to exclude certain non-operating items such as amortization of intangible assets.
kpis.description: Net Operating Income increased by 10% in 2025 to reach $2,883 million.

kpis.name: Tangible Equity Per Common Share
kpis.explanation: Value of a company's tangible equity divided by the number of common shares outstanding.
kpis.description: Tangible Equity Per Common Share increased by 7% to reach $117.45 at the end of 2025.
kpis.signal: Increase in tangible value per share.

risks.title: Economic Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to market fluctuations and changes in interest rates, which can have a significant impact on its business and results.

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: Deterioration in credit quality could negatively impact the company, particularly if borrowers are unable to repay their debts.

ai_positioning.summary: MTB does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or similar technologies in its 2025 10-K filing. No references to AI are present in the provided excerpts.
